testResults.name: local-command-surface
testResults.result: 15 focused tests passed for stable local API, ingest, reset, configuration, persistence, and dispatcher behavior

testResults.name: no-azure-authentication
testResults.result: Local API startup composes local catalog, file URL, filesystem, and DuckDB adapters; focused tests prove it does not construct or load an Azure credential

testResults.name: mandatory-alpaca-credentials
testResults.result: Local ingest requires non-empty Alpaca API key and secret environment variables before provider construction or state creation, never prints their values, and tests inject a fake provider without network access

testResults.name: bounded-local-persistence
testResults.result: A bounded AAPL ingest writes deterministic trade and quote Parquet paths plus atomically replaced JSON coverage; bounded results are accurately recorded as partial

testResults.name: bounded-real-alpaca-smoke
testResults.command: uv run lake local ingest --symbol AAPL --session-date 2026-09-01 --max-records 10
testResults.result: Using process-only credentials read transiently from the deployed Key Vault, local mode fetched 10 AAPL SIP trade rows and 10 quote rows, wrote 3,063-byte and 3,420-byte Parquet objects plus catalog coverage, reported both partitions as partial, and then removed the marker-owned local tree with lake local reset --yes

testResults.name: authenticated-api-and-query
testResults.result: The local FastAPI composition requires bearer authentication for v1 routes and executes bounded SQL over complete local Parquet partitions

testResults.name: safe-data-lifecycle
testResults.result: Local reset deletes only a marker-owned data tree; repository ignore rules cover the default .local data root and local secret files

testResults.name: runbook-and-agent-instruction
testResults.result: The runbook and scoped instruction document Python and uv prerequisites, process-only secrets, PowerShell and POSIX commands, authenticated API and real bounded Alpaca smoke paths, stop/reset steps, troubleshooting, and local-versus-Azure limitations

testResults.name: focused-quality-and-wave-integration
commands: uv run ruff check src/lake/local src/lake/cli/local.py tests/lake/local
uv run ruff format --check src/lake/local src/lake/cli/local.py tests/lake/local
uv run ty check src/lake/local src/lake/cli/local.py tests/lake/local
testResults.result: Focused quality checks and every frozen-wave integration gate passed

decisions: Supported local ingestion is always Alpaca-backed; fake providers are test-only and are not exposed as a local command mode.
The bounded smoke records partial coverage because a record cap can truncate provider results.
Local state is single-writer and intentionally excludes Azure queues, leases, SAS, managed identity, Key Vault, and distributed execution.
limitations: The existing Starlette/httpx deprecation warning is emitted by FastAPI TestClient.
